sav_input.mission: The procurement team and a CRM vendor must agree on commercial terms for a company-wide SaaS CRM deployment covering …
sav_input.final_decision:
{
  "a named support contact": "Named contact provided if buyer meets minimum annual spend/seat threshold; otherwise paid add-on",
  "a predictable price": "Fixed per-seat price for term + fixed support fee; no uplifts during initial term",
  "aligns to the company's budget cycle": "Annual PO/budget release clause: multi-year pricing locked but buyer obligated only upon yearly budget approval",
  "cap seat costs": "Blended average cost/user cap across full + light licenses, giving flexibility while controlling total seat cost",
  "commercial terms": "Separate line-items with auditable SOW: (1) licenses, (2) one-time onboarding, (3) premium support (annual) with SLA + credits",
  "company-wide SaaS CRM deployment": "Single global instance with centralized admin and standard config; optional add-on modules separately scoped/priced",
  "covering the full sales organisation": "Define \u201cfull sales org\u201d explicitly by role list (AEs/SDRs/AMs/Managers/Ops) + license types per role (full vs light)",
  "dedicated onboarding": "Dedicated onboarding team for 6\u201310 weeks with defined deliverables (config, data migration, training) in a fixed-fee SOW",
  "flexibility on term length": "24\u201336 month term with annual termination-for-convenience (e.g., 60\u201390 days notice + modest fee)",
  "higher annual fee": "Accept higher annual fee only with (a) named TAM, (b) 24/7 P1, and (c) fixed annual uplift cap (e.g., 0\u20133%)",
  "payment schedule": "Quarterly payments in arrears with no financing surcharge; co-terminus invoicing for add-ons",
  "premium support": "Two-tier premium support: Standard+ (business hours) vs Enterprise (24/7 + TAM) with buyer selecting tier"
}
